review_subject: M118 regional decoder: pre-deployment source review
review_context: Fresh delegated source review; plan and source files read directly. Same-family review, not cross-model acceptance.
scope: Source and existing completed Train evidence only. No M118 Torch execution, remote launch, new training or formal three-dataset result.

executed_checks.python_runtime: Existing uv-managed CPython 3.13.12; stdlib only. Python 3.8 syntax checked with ast.parse(feature_version=(3, 8)).
executed_checks.note: AST, artifact parsing, JSONL counting, ordinary scalar arithmetic and extracted existing summarize/paired_vs_empty functions were executed. Neither the Torch losses nor neural forwards were executed by this reviewer.

checks.evidence: For B states and 10 candidates, region/ring samples are [B,10,16/12,768]; initial samples broadcast over candidates. Four groups form [B*10,56,64] attention memory; query [B*10,5,64], current [B*10,16,64]. B concatenation is 64+64+64+64+5+1+13+1+1=277. The decision MLP has 277->64->1 and only its final weight is zero-initialized; total model parameters are 150528.

Ring expands xywh first, then samples the same RING subset of (roi_positions+1)/2. Both paths compute 2*(point-origin)/side-1 and use bilinear grid_sample, zeros padding and align_corners=False. Batched sampling changes tensor layout only. Persisted half tokens are converted to float before sampling, as in M117. Existing sanity compares three actual fit states for both region/ring with unmodified default assert_close; this GPU comparison has not yet run for M118.

Human mask is shared across all arms and has a valid category slot. Invalid query slots are masked in visual attention and pooled/direct-cosine readouts; independent query-to-memory reads do not mix query slots. Empty uses the same constant in both shared branches, with dropout=0, and centered full-null residual. Empty score/quality/index/box equality is enforced against frozen cached Parent inputs. The learned 277-dimensional selected_feature is checked against the selected candidate in that forward, not against the pretraining state or Parent64. Final metadata and plan now state this exact boundary.

Both Parent input builder and M118 inputs exclude iou; key/strata are not tensor inputs. Forward uses dense observations, legal initialization, human bank, candidate geometry and frozen Parent outputs. Geometry derives from native scores/cells/boxes/prior, not current GT. Current GT determines offline candidate IoU, loss and reporting only. Existing artifacts show 2544 fit+495 development valid states; 463 invalid-GT events are omitted. The separate 355 fit/108 development all-zero-IoU states remain valid cases without fabricated positive order pairs.

Positive IoU difference weights the pairwise hinge with the IoU difference as margin; equal/all-zero pairs contribute zero and all candidates with distinct quality are eligible. Parent preservation uses the Parent argmax only when its GT IoU>=0.5 and protects its original score gap against every strictly lower-IoU candidate, including still-qualified candidates; a better-IoU candidate is not protected against. Weights are fixed at one. Real fit targets contain 95260 positive ordered quality pairs and 14135 protected Parent pairs per complete pass. IoU is localization quality, not physical-instance or phrase-visibility truth.

Parent checkpoint must match original result and fixed SHA 1d187d78c1dd76ebf59e41fd31af16fa69cecc37b4cb6c74fbdfe3ed5c237293. It is eval/requires_grad(False), evaluated once per panel load in canonical64 groups, then deleted after score/quality/64-dimensional feature caching. State_dict parameters and buffers are compared with torch.equal (exact tensor values). Development argmax must match original M101 rows. No Parent recomputation occurs in shuffled minibatches. Each separate sanity/train arm process loads/caches its own Parent once; this is not one global forward shared across all six processes.

All arms create the same 150528-parameter model after resetting seed2027. CPU initialization and per-epoch Generator(2027+epoch) give the same initialization construction and sample order. Suite compares actual initial state digests among all three arms in each phase. Sanity repeats the same first seed2027 minibatch for three updates; full training starts a fresh process/model, with 40 minibatches*12 epochs=480 steps. AdamW lr=3e-4 and default weight decay; fixed final only. Model stays eval with autograd enabled and no attention dropout. Sanity checks final finite positive gradients for both projections, both attentions and decision head.

human_text remains the permanent primary protocol; generic and visual_query are expressly controls. visual_query uses the initial local dense RGB representation repeated over the same human-derived slot mask; generic uses object. Same architecture and nominal parameter budget are matched, not a claim of identical input information/effective function. Extra frozen CLIP RGB capacity, shared Empty text constant, human slot-count metadata, reused development set and four-attribute truncation are disclosed. No claim that this is the untrained native baseline.

Index, box, score, quality and feature are gathered from the same chosen candidate; evaluator asserts these identities and finite values. Empty final/start rows retain score and selection equality; quality is compared to cached Parent on every evaluation. Each arm emits fit and all four development content readouts, candidate IoUs, score deltas and final tensor roundtrip. Existing summarize and paired_vs_empty were AST-extracted and executed against real stored rows. Native rescues/breaks cross 0.5 relative to candidate0; own-Empty rescue/harm use <=0.1 versus >=0.5. Final metric_definitions and plan state this difference. Own-Empty gates are emitted by trainer; cross-arm correct/mean comparisons remain a completion analysis requirement, with no automatic promotion.

Two arms run on GPUs0/1 then the third on GPU0; all three sanity results are validated before phase(train). Every child has stdout/stderr log, launch metadata and exit file; failures stop the phase after joining its active wave, and no automatic retry occurs. Success driver.exit is written only after all phases. Controller traceback remains in controller.log on failure. Deployer verifies the review and final source/private transport bytes before connection, compares stable remote dependencies, uploads only intended new files/review, requires absent output/private directory, and starts one detached controller. Existing environment/caches are used; there is no install/download/cleanup. Credentials are read only from stdin for the authorized 43811 endpoint. No deployer or embedded remote command was executed by this reviewer.

resolved_during_review.issue: Legacy reporting helpers use two different rescue/harm reference/threshold conventions.
resolved_during_review.resolution: Executor added metric_definitions and plan wording. On the same real M117 development choices, all 0.5 crossings against Parent are 20/42 while the severe <=0.1<->>=0.5 reporter is 11/13; both are now explicitly distinguished. No metric function, loss or gate was changed.

remaining_runtime_requirements: Actual M118 three-arm GPU sanity: original-reader assert_close, finite positive gradients, all3039 Empty score/quality/index/box checks, frozen Parent state, and initial-state equality.
After all three sanity passes, existing full suite must complete all three 480-step final fits and exact state serialization checks.

Completion analysis must compare human against its own Empty and the separately trained generic/visual_query arms, with the preregistered correct-count, mean-IoU, healthy and transition conditions. Save both full 0.5-crossing and severe rescue/harm definitions separately.
interpretation_limits: This PASS permits proceeding through the existing sanity gate; it is not a passed M118 runtime result.

Fixed native Train states and repeatedly used development data do not establish recursive tracking gains, C-memory behavior, missing-candidate/regression capacity, Full152 final training or any formal Test/CDTB/VOT result.
Same-family fresh context and requested model/effort routing are not independent cross-family or backend attestation.
